items.en: Iran Fires Missiles and Drones at U.S. Bases in Jordan and the UAE After American Strike on Larak Island
items.zh: 伊朗以飛彈無人機反擊約旦、阿聯美軍基地，中東停火一個月後再度開打
items.summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launched missiles and drones at the King Hussein and Al Azraq air bases in Jordan overnight, claiming heavy damage to infrastructure and aircraft positions. The strikes were retaliation for a U.S. attack on two Iranian rocket launchers on Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz. Jordan said its air defences intercepted and destroyed eight missiles. The UAE denied reports of a missile attack on Al Minhad Air Base but confirmed it downed a drone approaching from Iran over its territorial waters. It is the first major fighting in the region in over a month, and President Trump has publicly teased retaliation against Kharg Island, Iran's main oil export terminal.

items.en: Nepal-Tibet Glacier Collapse Death Toll Passes 950 as Rescuers Race to Reach 900 Trapped Hydropower Workers
items.zh: 尼泊爾與西藏冰川崩塌洪災死亡逾 950 人，900 名水電廠工人受困隧道
items.summary: An unprecedented deluge of ice, rock, mud and debris triggered by a glacier collapse on the Nepal-Tibet border has killed 903 people in Nepal with 4,247 missing, plus at least 16 dead and 546 missing across the border in China's Tibet region. Rescue teams aided by Chinese and Indian experts are racing to reach more than 900 workers unaccounted for at 12 damaged hydropower projects in Nepal's Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts, with at least 500 believed trapped in tunnels blocked by mud and rock. The Red Cross estimates more than 90,000 people have been affected by the disaster.

items.en: Two Dead and 14 Unaccounted For After Flash Flood Tears Through the Grand Canyon
items.zh: 大峽谷暴洪造成 2 死 14 人失聯，峽谷內唯一輸水管線被沖毀
items.summary: At least two people have been killed by a flash flood that struck the Bright Angel Canyon and Phantom Ranch area of Grand Canyon National Park on Saturday afternoon. The body of a 46-year-old man was recovered near Crystal Rapids on Sunday evening and a second body was found on Monday. The park service says at least 14 other people may be missing or unaccounted for, and more than 60 people were evacuated by air. The flood destroyed the only water pipeline in the canyon, forcing emergency water restrictions on year-round residents, and forecasters warned more storms were possible.

items.en: Oil Jumps Above $90 as Strait of Hormuz Fighting Resumes, Reviving Inflation Fears
items.zh: 荷莫茲海峽戰火重燃，布蘭特原油衝破 90 美元，通膨疑慮再起
items.summary: Brent crude rose 2.93% to about $90.69 a barrel and WTI climbed 2.57% to $85.54 on Monday after the U.S. and Iran traded strikes, up from $87 Brent at the end of July. Roughly a fifth of the world's seaborne oil moves through the Strait of Hormuz, so a sustained exchange feeds directly into crude prices, shipping insurance costs and headline inflation. The move landed days after Federal Reserve chair Kevin Warsh used his first Jackson Hole address to warn that inflation remains too high, leaving markets pricing a meaningful chance of a September rate hike rather than a cut.

items.en: Ferry Carrying Hundreds Capsizes off Northern Cyprus, at Least Eight Dead
items.zh: 賽普勒斯北岸渡輪翻覆，至少 8 死、多人失蹤
items.summary: At least eight people are dead and more remain missing after a ferry carrying hundreds of passengers capsized off the northern coast of Cyprus while on a crossing toward Turkey. Search-and-rescue vessels from Cyprus, Turkey and Greece joined the operation, pulling survivors from the eastern Mediterranean through the night. The incident is the second mass-casualty maritime accident in the region this summer and has renewed scrutiny of passenger-capacity enforcement and safety inspections on short-haul Mediterranean ferry routes.

items.en: Anthropic Force-Signs Out Claude Users and Refunds Charges After Infostealer Malware Hijacks Sessions
items.zh: 竊密惡意程式盜用 Claude 登入工作階段，Anthropic 全面登出用戶並退款
items.summary: Anthropic is signing affected Claude users out of their accounts, wiping saved payment methods and refunding unauthorised charges after infostealer malware running on users' own PCs siphoned active Claude login sessions and consumed usage limits without permission. The compromise happened on the client side rather than in Anthropic's infrastructure, but the company chose a blanket session invalidation as the safest response. Separately, Anthropic's preliminary second-quarter revenue came in above $11.5 billion, a more than fourteen-fold jump year on year, with positive adjusted operating income for the first time in the company's history.

items.en: OpenAI Previews Ultrafast Mode Running GPT-5.6 Sol 14x Faster on Cerebras Hardware
items.zh: OpenAI 推出 Ultrafast 模式，GPT-5.6 Sol 速度提升 14 倍、每秒 750 tokens
items.summary: OpenAI is previewing Ultrafast mode, a new API tier that runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to fourteen times faster than standard processing, reaching as much as 750 output tokens per second on Cerebras hardware. The tier is aimed at agentic and real-time coding workloads where latency, not raw capability, is the bottleneck. In a separate move, OpenAI said it will cut off Cursor's direct model access on November 12 following Cursor's acquisition by SpaceX, forcing the coding tool to route through other providers or its own models.

items.en: NPR and NewsGuard Test Six Chatbots Against State Disinformation; Claude and Rivals Debunk About Three Quarters
items.zh: NPR 與 NewsGuard 測試六大聊天機器人，對國家級假訊息辨識率約七成五
items.summary: NPR partnered with NewsGuard to test six major chatbots — ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Meta AI, Grok and Claude — against thirty false narratives pushed by China, Iran and Russia. The assistants correctly debunked the falsehoods roughly three quarters of the time, outperforming conventional search engines including Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo and Yandex on the same prompts. Researchers cautioned that the remaining quarter matters most, because failures clustered on narratives with thin authoritative English-language coverage, exactly the gap state information operations are designed to exploit.

items.en: Alcaraz Returns From Wrist Injury With Straight-Sets Win in US Open First Round
items.zh: 艾卡拉茲手腕傷癒復出，US Open 首輪直落三過關
items.summary: Carlos Alcaraz beat Roman Safiullin 6-4, 6-4, 6-4 in just over two hours and twenty minutes on Monday, his first tour-level singles match since injuring his right wrist at the Barcelona Open in April. The defending champion and second seed showed no obvious protection of the wrist on his forehand and served his way out of the only two break points he faced. His draw opens up considerably before the quarter-finals, and the performance immediately reinstated him as co-favourite alongside the top seed.

items.en: Sabalenka Opens Bid for Third Straight US Open Title With Win Over Osorio
items.zh: 莎巴倫卡首輪擊敗奧索里歐，展開 US Open 三連霸之路
items.summary: World number one Aryna Sabalenka beat Camila Osorio 6-4, 6-4 to begin her attempt to become the first player to win three consecutive US Open women's singles titles since Serena Williams in 2012-14. Sabalenka struggled with her first-serve percentage in the opening set but converted four of seven break points overall. Two-time champion Naomi Osaka also featured in Monday's evening session on Arthur Ashe Stadium against Anastasia Zakharova, in the pair's first career meeting.

items.en: Premier League Season Enters Round Three With Manchester City and Liverpool Already Separated
items.zh: 英超第三輪開打，曼城大勝水晶宮、利物浦被諾丁漢森林逼平
items.summary: The 2026-27 Premier League season, which began on 22 August, delivered an early separation in the title race over the weekend as Manchester City won 4-1 away at Crystal Palace while Liverpool were held to a 2-2 draw at home by Nottingham Forest. City's away performance was built on a first-half three-goal burst, while Liverpool twice surrendered the lead. With the first international break approaching, the results give City an early psychological edge in what most analysts still expect to be a two-horse race.

items.en: New Research Shows Emotion and Rumination Are What Make Negative Interpretations Stick
items.zh: 新研究：情緒與反芻思考，才是負面解讀「黏住」的真正原因
items.summary: Research published on August 31 examined why negative interpretations of ambiguous events persist even after contradictory evidence appears. The work found that emotional intensity at the moment of encoding, combined with subsequent rumination, predicts persistence far better than the plausibility of the interpretation itself. The practical implication is that arguing with the content of a negative thought is less effective than interrupting the rumination loop that keeps rehearsing it, which supports behavioural activation and attention-training approaches over purely cognitive disputation.

items.en: Solitude, Hobbies and Distraction Work as Well as Socialising for Coping With Loneliness
items.zh: 研究：獨處、興趣與轉移注意力，緩解孤獨感的效果不輸社交
items.summary: A study reported on August 28 found that while connecting with others helps people cope with loneliness, self-initiated strategies including deliberate solitude, absorbing hobbies and distraction produced comparable reductions in distress. The finding matters because the dominant public-health framing treats loneliness as a deficit of social contact, which can leave people who cannot easily increase contact feeling that no remedy is available to them. The authors argue interventions should present a menu of strategies rather than prescribing socialising as the single route.

items.en: Survey of 31,000 Vocational Students Maps Gaps in School Psychological Education
items.zh: 31,000 名技職學生調查：學校心理教育的落差在哪裡
items.summary: A large survey of roughly 31,000 secondary vocational school students, published in Frontiers in Psychology, mapped the current state of psychological education provision and its relationship to student mental health outcomes. The study found that formal provision was widely present on paper but that perceived accessibility varied sharply by school, and that perceived accessibility rather than nominal provision predicted help-seeking. The authors recommend measuring student-reported access rather than programme existence when evaluating school mental-health policy.

items.en: SEMICON Taiwan 2026 Opens in Taipei With a Record 18 Countries and AI Interconnect as the Central Bottleneck
items.zh: SEMICON Taiwan 2026 台北開幕，18 國參展創紀錄，主軸是「AI 晶片之間的連線」
items.summary: SEMICON Taiwan 2026 opened its forum programme on August 31 at the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center, with the exhibition running September 2-4 and more than 100,000 semiconductor professionals from 65 countries expected. The organisers framed this year's central technical problem as interconnect rather than raw compute: the wires and optics linking AI accelerators now gate system performance. New for 2026 are a Quantum Technology zone, a Wafer Smart Manufacturing zone and a Chiplet zone inside the advanced-packaging area, alongside forums on silicon photonics and cryogenic electronics.

items.en: MSCI Adds Nanya Technology, Winbond and Phison to Its Global Standard Index, Effective at Monday's Taiwan Close
items.zh: MSCI 全球標準指數納入南亞科、華邦電、群聯，8/31 收盤後生效
items.summary: MSCI's August quarterly review, announced on August 13, added six Taiwanese names to its Global Standard Index and removed six, with memory makers Nanya Technology, Winbond and Phison the headline inclusions. The changes took effect after Monday's Taipei close, producing a heavy closing auction with TSMC alone trading more than 14,000 lots in the final minutes. TSMC's index weight was cut 0.79 percentage points to 56.61%, while Nanya Technology gained the most weight at 0.49%. Institutional investors had been building positions since the announcement date.

items.en: Finnish Startup S-Transistors Raises Pre-Seed to Build Superconducting Transistors for Millikelvin Quantum Control
items.zh: 芬蘭新創 S-Transistors 募得 260 萬歐元，開發毫克耳文超導電晶體
items.summary: S-Transistors secured 2.6 million euros in pre-seed funding on August 31 to set up a pilot manufacturing line and a cryogenic laboratory. The company is developing superconducting transistors that operate at millikelvin temperatures, targeting the thermal bottleneck that currently limits how many qubits a single dilution refrigerator can control. Conventional CMOS control electronics dissipate too much heat to sit next to the qubits, forcing long wire runs that add noise and cost, so on-chip cryogenic control is one of the recognised prerequisites for scaling beyond a few thousand physical qubits.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE to Release Sixth Studio Album on September 30, First Arena Tour in Three Years to Follow
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第六張原創專輯 9/30 發行，三年來首次巡迴接著開跑
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE will release their sixth original full-length album on September 30, their first since the stadium run earlier this year, and follow it with their first arena tour in three years. The band's ZENJIN MITO TO IM/MUTABLE stadium tour, which opened in April 2026 and played Japan National Stadium and Yanmar Stadium Nagai, drew a combined 390,000 people, with live viewings staged in Taiwan, Hong Kong, South Korea and Thailand. Taiwan and Hong Kong fans should watch for a live-viewing announcement rather than a local date.

items.en: LiSA Marks 15th Solo Anniversary With Her Largest Overseas Run, Including Taiwan and Hong Kong
items.zh: LiSA solo 出道 15 週年，史上最大規模海外巡迴含台灣、香港場
items.summary: LiSA is marking her fifteenth anniversary as a solo artist with the largest overseas run of her career: an Asia tour covering Malaysia, Taiwan, Hong Kong and South Korea, followed by her first ever headline shows in Europe and the United Kingdom. For fans in Taiwan this is the concrete one to track, since it is a full headline date rather than a live viewing. Ticketing for Asian legs of Japanese arena tours typically opens two to three months ahead through local promoters, so the window to watch is now.

items.en: YOASOBI Announce 10-City Dome and Stadium Tour Across Japan and Asia With Overseas Venues Still TBA
items.zh: YOASOBI 宣布 10 城巨蛋暨體育場巡迴，亞洲場地待公布
items.summary: YOASOBI have announced a ten-city dome and stadium tour spanning Japan and Asia, with overseas dates and venues still to be announced, on top of the Never Ending Stories North American run that opened at Boston's TD Garden in August and includes Barclays Center, the Hollywood Bowl, Lollapalooza in Chicago and their first Canadian show at Osheaga. Their previous Asia tour began in Hong Kong and ended in New Taipei City, so both markets are live possibilities for the Asian leg.

items.en: Ado's First Greatest-Hits Album Marks Five Years Since Major-Label Debut
items.zh: Ado 首張精選輯 Ado's Best Adobum 紀念主流出道五週年
items.summary: Ado's first greatest-hits collection, Ado's Best Adobum, marks five years since her major-label debut and gathers the singles that took her from a Niconico upload to the Hibana world tour, which ran from Saitama Super Arena in April 2025 to Honolulu that August. No new Asian tour dates have been announced since, so the album is the current release to follow rather than a ticket to chase. The collection also includes the Mrs. GREEN APPLE-written I'm invincible, a rare direct crossover between two artists on this list.

market.asOf: 台股 2026/08/31（週一）收盤 · 美股 2026/08/31（週一）收盤 —— 今天 9/1（二）台股 09:00 開盤、美股台北時間今晚 21:30 開盤；原油為 8/31 盤中、黃金與加密貨幣為近即時報價
market.note: ★ 8/31 是「兩件事同時發生」的一天，而且兩件事互相抵銷後仍然收黑。　【台股 8/31】加權指數收 46,128.47 點、跌 202.98 點（-0.44%），但這個 -0.44% 嚴重低估了盤中的驚險——盤中一度重挫 881 點、跌破 46,000 觸及 45,450.21，是靠低接買盤一路收斂回來的。成交金額 1 兆 2,017.92 億元再放大，三大法人在集中與櫃買市場同步站賣方、兩市合計賣超逾 300 億元。家數上「跌多漲少」非常明顯：上漲 611 家、下跌 1,173 家，漲停 23 檔、跌停 7 檔。　壓力來自兩個方向：① 美伊在荷莫茲海峽重新開打、油價跳 3%，亞股開盤先反應地緣風險 ② MSCI 成分股調整在收盤後生效，被動資金要買南亞科、華邦電、群聯，錢就得從其他成分股抽走，權重被調降的個股（最典型是日月光 -5.96%）在生效日承受技術性賣壓。台積電尾盤爆出逾 1.4 萬張大量、收 2,405 元（-0.62%），就是這股調整買賣盤的痕跡。　【美股 8/31】三大指數同步收黑但幅度不大：那斯達克 26,370.89（-0.64%）、S&P 500 7,686.14（-0.58%）、道瓊 53,185.90（-374.09 點、-0.72%）。原因單一：美伊互擊讓布蘭特原油衝上 90.69 美元（+2.93%）、WTI 85.54 美元（+2.57%），油價直接餵養通膨與升息預期。8 月整體仍是收紅月份，但最後一個交易日把氣氛壓下去了。　★ 個股層面才是今天真正的重點：那斯達克最大輸家 PayPal 崩 14.3%（Advent＋Stripe 財團放棄收購），Marvell 再跌 12.3%（財報好但 Google 訂單認列遞延到 FY2029）。這兩檔都在你的觀察清單裡，而且跌的理由完全不同——一個是「併購題材消失」，一個是「好消息但時間點不對」。
market.highlight: 🔭 這週要盯的三件事：　① 【9 月 FOMC 是最大變數】Fed 主席 Warsh 在 Jackson Hole 把市場預期從「降息」扭轉成「9 月升息機率約 57%」，而 8/31 的油價跳升又往同一個方向加碼。如果 9 月真的升息，被修理的順序大致是：加密相關（COIN、MSTR、CRCL、HOOD）→ 高評價成長股 → 一般科技股，防禦型（JNJ、PG、KO）與能源相對抗跌。你清單裡加密部位不算小，這是最該先想清楚的一塊。　② 【記憶體是現在唯一台美同步的主題】8/31 美股 SanDisk +5.5%、美光 +2.5%；台股 MSCI 把南亞科、華邦電、群聯三檔一起納入全球標準指數。但要注意時間差：法人從 8/13 公布日就卡位了兩週，生效日（8/31）南亞科只 +0.56%、華邦電 +0.55%，這就是典型的「利多兌現」。追高的風險現在比兩週前高很多。　③ 【SEMICON Taiwan 今天開幕，主軸是散熱與連線】9/2–9/4 在南港展覽館，18 國參展創紀錄，今年新增量子技術專區與 Chiplet 專區。主辦方把今年的技術瓶頸定調在「晶片之間的連線」而不是算力本身——對應到你的清單，就是散熱（奇鋐 3017、雙鴻 3324、健策 3653）與高速板材（台光電 2383、金像電 2368、華通 2313）這兩條線。8/31 台股大跌那天，這兩條線的多數個股是收紅的，值得留意。　⚠️ 清單外值得記一下的新面孔：南亞（1303，玻纖布／CCL，漲停）、鴻勁（7769，測試分選機）、國巨*（2327，被動元件）、SanDisk（SNDK，NAND）。前三檔都跟你既有的 AI 供應鏈有關，只是站在不同節點。

movers.name: GoPro
movers.reason: ★★ 清單外爆量新標的 · 8/31 單日 +43.5%、收在 0.88 美元。這是典型的低價股軋空行情（股價不到 1 美元、流通市值極小，任何消息都會被放大成數十個百分點）。放在最上方只是提醒你「它今天出現在漲幅榜第一」，不是推薦——這種標的的下跌速度和上漲速度一樣快，而且它跟你觀察清單的 AI／半導體主線完全沒有關係。

movers.name: 南亞
movers.reason: ★★ 清單外新標的 · 8/31 攻上漲停 242.5 元，是當天台股最強的權值型個股，也是大盤重挫 881 點時少數逆勢鎖漲停的標的。南亞是塑化股，但這波的題材不是塑化景氣，而是它的電子材料事業——玻纖布與 CCL（銅箔基板）直接吃 AI 伺服器高速板材需求，跟你清單裡的台光電（2383）、金像電（2368）是同一條供應鏈的上游。值得注意的是同日台光電只有 -0.09%、金像電 +3.10%，上游反而比下游強，代表市場在追「材料端漲價」而不是「板廠出貨」。

movers.name: 鴻勁
movers.reason: ★ 清單外 · 半導體測試設備（測試分選機）龍頭，8/31 重挫 9.71% 收 5,860 元。高價股在大盤急殺時本來就跌得兇，加上前一日才創波段高 6,490，屬於獲利了結型的回檔。這檔跟你清單裡的世芯（3661）、創意（3443）同屬 AI 晶片產業鏈的後段，可以當作「這條鏈今天在收縮」的溫度計。

movers.name: 國巨*
movers.reason: ★ 清單外 · 被動元件龍頭，8/31 跌 8.71% 收 545 元，前一交易日才剛從 555 衝到 597（+7.6%），等於一天內把兩天的漲幅全吐回去。被動元件是最典型的「跟著景氣循環大起大落」族群，這種來回劇烈震盪通常代表短線資金在裡面打架，而不是基本面轉向。

movers.name: 欣興
movers.reason: ⚠️ 你的清單標的 · 8/31 開盤即跌停鎖死在 999 元，全天沒打開。原因是產地標示爭議事件——這是公司治理／法遵層面的風險，不是需求或訂單問題，所以它跟同族群完全脫鉤（同日台光電 -0.09%、金像電 +3.10%、華通 +3.11% 都比它好太多）。一價鎖死代表賣單掛不完，隔天開盤前要先看有沒有進一步的公司說明或主管機關動作；載板與 ABF 的基本面題材沒有變，變的是這家公司本身。

movers.name: 雙鴻
movers.reason: 你的清單標的 · 散熱模組，最近交易日大漲約 8%（+85 元）至 1,145 元。散熱是 8/31 台股在大跌中少數整族群走強的方向：奇鋐（3017）+1.93%、健策（3653）+3.54%、雙鴻最強。邏輯很直接——SEMICON Taiwan 今天開幕，主軸講的是「AI 晶片之間的連線與熱」，液冷與散熱是這次展會最被點名的瓶頸。⚠️ 這筆報價來源未標明確切日期，以最近交易日計，若隔天發現對不上會在明天晨報更正。

movers.name: 日月光投控
movers.reason: 你的清單標的 · 8/31 重挫 5.96% 收 584 元，是台股權值股中跌最深的一檔。封測是 MSCI 這次調整的「資金排擠」受害方——被動基金要買進南亞科、華邦電、群聯，錢就得從別的成分股身上抽，權重被調降的個股在生效日常會出現這種賣壓。這是技術性賣壓、不是先進封裝需求出問題，但生效日過後幾天要觀察買盤有沒有回來。

movers.name: PayPal
movers.reason: ⚠️ 你的清單標的 · 8/31 崩跌 14.3%，是那斯達克當天最大輸家。Bloomberg 報導由私募 Advent 與支付商 Stripe 組成的財團決定放棄收購 PayPal——雙方在估值上談不攏，財團原先出價每股 60.50 美元，PayPal 董事會認為不足。收購題材消失後，股價直接跌回「沒有併購溢價」的水位，PayPal 得靠自己完成營運轉型，同時還要面對 Apple Pay 與 Google 的競爭。你清單裡把它歸在「價值修復」，這次事件等於把修復的時間軸整個往後推。

movers.name: Marvell
movers.reason: ⚠️ 你的清單標的 · 8/31 再跌 12.3%，是 8/28 財報後的第二段下殺（兩天累計跌逾 17%）。矛盾點在於：Q2 營收與 EPS 都超預期（EPS 0.94 美元、營收 27.4 億美元），全年展望也上修到年增約 50%、約 180 億美元，但市場砍的是「時間」與「品質」——Google 客製晶片合作的增量營收要遞延到 FY2029 才認列，而且客製矽的毛利率低於傳統網通產品。這是 AI 供應鏈很值得記住的一課：拿到大單不等於馬上賺到錢，市場對「什麼時候入帳、賺多少毛利」比對「單子多大」更敏感。

movers.name: ServiceNow
